lines.en: Good morning. Where are you going?

lines.es: Buenos días. Quiero un billete para Toledo, por favor.
lines.en: Good morning. I'd like a ticket to Toledo, please.
One way or return?

lines.es: De ida y vuelta. Vuelvo esta tarde.
lines.en: Return. I'm coming back this afternoon.

lines.es: Muy bien. Hay un tren a las nueve y media. ¿Te va bien?
lines.en: Very good. There's a train at half past nine. Is that OK for you?
Yes, perfect. How long is the journey?
About half an hour.
That's fast! How much is it?
That's twenty euros.
Here you are. Which platform does it leave from?

lines.es: Del andén cinco. Mira las pantallas.
lines.en: From platform five. Look at the screens.
OK, thank you very much.
You're welcome. Have a good trip!

lines.es: Perdone, ¿me puede ayudar? Me he perdido un poco.
lines.en: Excuse me, can you help me? I'm a little lost.
Of course! Where are you going?
I want to go to the cathedral.

lines.es: Está muy cerca. Sigue todo recto por esta calle.
lines.en: It's very close. Go straight on along this street.
Straight on?

lines.es: Sí, y luego gira a la izquierda. Hay una cuesta.
lines.en: Yes, and then turn left. There's a slope.
The streets here are very narrow!

lines.es: Sí, son de piedra y muy antiguas. Es el casco antiguo.
lines.en: Yes, they're made of stone and very old. It's the old town.

lines.es: Es muy bonito. Cada calle es una sorpresa.
lines.en: It's very pretty. Every street is a surprise.
Is it your first time in Toledo?

lines.es: Sí, vivo en Madrid. Hoy he venido en tren.
lines.en: Yes, I live in Madrid. Today I came by train.
Well, welcome! Enjoy the city.
Thank you very much! Goodbye.
Hi, good afternoon. Are you having lunch?

lines.es: Sí, por favor. ¿Tenéis menú del día?
lines.en: Yes, please. Do you have a set menu?

lines.es: Sí. De primero hay sopa o ensalada.
lines.en: Yes. For the first course there's soup or salad.
Soup, please.

lines.es: Y de segundo, carne con patatas o pescado.
lines.en: And for the main course, meat with potatoes or fish.
Meat with potatoes.
Very good. And to drink?
Water, please.

lines.es: El menú incluye pan y postre.
lines.en: The menu includes bread and dessert.
Great! I'll sit here, in the sun.
How's the food?

lines.es: Todo está muy rico, gracias. La cuenta, por favor.
lines.en: Everything is delicious, thanks. The bill, please.
Of course. That's fourteen euros.
Hi, good afternoon. What would you like?
Hi. What is this?

lines.es: Es mazapán. Es un dulce típico de Toledo.
lines.en: It's marzipan. It's a typical sweet from Toledo.
How pretty! Can I try one?
Of course, here you are.
Mmm… It's delicious!
Would you like a box?

lines.es: Sí, una caja pequeña, por favor. Es un regalo para mi madre.
lines.en: Yes, a small box, please. It's a present for my mother.
How thoughtful! Shall I wrap it for you?
Yes, please.
Here you are. That's eight euros.

lines.es: Gracias. ¡Le voy a mandar una foto!
lines.en: Thanks. I'm going to send her a photo!
I'm sure she'll love it!
Bye, see you!

narr.intro: Welcome! Today, practise real conversations from Elena's first train trip to Toledo. First listen, then repeat each line.
narr.c2: Conversation two: in the old town.
narr.c4: Conversation four: at the sweet shop.
narr.outro: Well done! See you next week.
